report_parsed.summary: Authorized 300s window (policy-window-1, 2026-09-27T12:29:20Z–12:34:20Z, target m0-otel-20260909). Trace evidence shows a real, repeated checkout failure signature: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans tagged error with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 13, whose status description and exception log read 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', surfaced to the caller as HTTP 500 through frontend POST /api/checkout and frontend-proxy ingress. The same message appears as the error on payment-service grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server spans, and in at least trace 2ae907f7f6fe3a65cfd0d94b5b98fed7 the visible parent references form frontend-proxy → frontend → checkout PlaceOrder → checkout-side Charge client span (status code 2) → payment Charge server span, i.e. the failure is confined to the payment charge call inside checkout. The other checkout dependencies sampled in-window show no error tags and sub-10 ms server-side durations (cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog); email traces returned no data (status no_data), so email status is unknown, not healthy. Two metric views contradict the error picture: traces_span_metrics_calls_total for checkout and payment with STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and checkout PlaceOrder span counts, report 0 in the same window, so error rate cannot be quantified from those series. Latency: checkout-side client p95 values for Convert/GetCart/GetProduct/GetQuote are single-digit to ~9.6 ms with NaN for Charge/EmptyCart/ShipOrder; no baseline window was queried, so no latency trend can be asserted. Conclusion: failures are observed and localized to payment-charge failures breaking checkout; elevated latency across checkout dependencies is not established.

claims.text: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans in service checkout were returned with error_by_visible_tags=true, otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 13, with status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; observed trace ids 2ae907f7f6fe3a65cfd0d94b5b98fed7 (37570us), 9f6e08653f53d6c66e26fa5491593e9f (24798us), 97a61f6b6f8441ab5575ebda9a357513 (19526us), 620959b95412ef797a11791a1dd80e15 (17483us), 4b03188d4367e27f85ad2a8aafdb4e89 (12307us), 3bbf07ccb0295a4896f05401190b958c (6726us).

payment service returned six grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans with error tags ('Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', exception at charge.js:37) in traces 2ae907f7f6fe3a65cfd0d94b5b98fed7, 97a61f6b6f8441ab5575ebda9a357513, 9f6e08653f53d6c66e26fa5491593e9f, 4b03188d4367e27f85ad2a8aafdb4e89, 620959b95412ef797a11791a1dd80e15 and 3bbf07ccb0295a4896f05401190b958c, with service-side durations of roughly 0.6-10.1 ms; the view was truncated (returned 18 of 20 rows).

Visible parent references in sampled traces place the failure chain frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' (HTTP 500) → frontend 'POST' / 'POST /api/checkout' (HTTP 500) → frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) → checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (code 13) → checkout child span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (rpc.grpc.status_code 2) → payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (ERROR), for example in trace 2ae907f7f6fe3a65cfd0d94b5b98fed7; checkout side spans in the same trace report the same charge-card failure text.

Frontend checkout traffic is also failing independently in a second sampled trace: trace 620959b95412ef797a11791a1dd80e15 shows frontend spans with http.status_code 500 for 'POST' and 'POST /api/checkout' plus 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' carrying exception type 13 and message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... Invalid token.', while unrelated frontend routes in the same sample (for example GET /api/data, GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations) returned http.status_code 200.

currency service spans in the window are clean: 20 sampled Currency/Convert spans carry otel.status_code OK and rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with durations between about 186us and 893us, and checkout-side client metrics for oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert report 15 calls at grpc status code 0.

shipping spans are clean in the window: oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote spans in service shipping show rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with durations up to about 6.1 ms, their child HTTP POST spans show http.status_code 200, and checkout-side client metrics for GetQuote report 3.75 calls at grpc status code 0.

cart service spans in the window carry no error tags: 20 sampled cart spans ('POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem' and redis HGET children) show durations up to about 7.4 ms with empty status tags, checkout-side client metrics for CartService/GetCart report 3.75 calls at grpc status code 0, and the cart HTTP server metric records 60 responses with http_response_status_code 200 in the 300s window.

product-catalog sampled spans show no failures: 20 spans (GetProduct/ListProducts) all report rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with durations between about 105us and 2562us, checkout-side client metrics for ProductCatalogService/GetProduct report 11.25 calls at grpc status code 0, and server-side rpc counts show GetProduct 92.5 and ListProducts 6.25; the trace view itself is marked incomplete.

Checkout-side client latency in the window is single-digit milliseconds for the methods that did report a quantile: p95 rpc_client_duration_milliseconds for oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 4.75, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 9.25, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.75 and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 9.625, while Charge, EmptyCart and ShipOrder return NaN; server-side p95 in the same window shows product-catalog 4.75 and checkout NaN.

The payment business counter shows no successful transactions recorded in the window: increase(app_payment_transactions_total[300s]) is 0 for both the CAD and USD series of service payment in this 300s range.

Error-tagged span counters do not corroborate the failures seen in traces: traces_span_metrics_calls_total increase over the window is 0 for checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR, 0 for payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and 0 for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge under STATUS_CODE_ERROR, so the checkout/payment error rate cannot be quantified from these series despite six errored PlaceOrder spans appearing in trace search.

Checkout call-count series understate observed traffic and error calls: checkout client counts for PaymentService/Charge are 0 at both grpc status code 0 and code 2, server-side rpc duration counts for checkout PlaceOrder are 0, and checkout span-name counts for PlaceOrder are 0 for both STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET, while trace search returned six error PlaceOrder spans and six checkout-side Charge spans with rpc.grpc.status_code 2 in the same window.

Rejected as the source of the checkout failures: the cart, currency, shipping and product-catalog dependencies. Their spans in this window carry no error tags (currency Convert otel.status_code OK / grpc 0; shipping GetQuote grpc 0 with HTTP 200 children; cart spans and redis HGET children untagged; product-catalog GetProduct/ListProducts grpc 0), while every sampled PlaceOrder error is accompanied by a payment Charge error span.

The checkout error burst is caused by the payment charge path rejecting charges with 'Invalid token' (an error raised inside the payment application at charge.js:37), which propagates as code 13 INTERNAL to checkout PlaceOrder and as HTTP 500 through frontend to the load generator; whether the invalid token originates from configuration, request payload or feature-flag state is not determined by the supplied evidence.

A feature-flag evaluation may gate the failing charge path, since one failing payment Charge span has a child span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (rpc.grpc.status_code 0, about 5.6 ms) in trace 2ae907f7f6fe3a65cfd0d94b5b98fed7; no flag key, value or evaluation result is available in the supplied evidence, so this remains unverified.
